# Timxpert

> Timxpert (Timothy Goodness) is a motion designer and video producer who makes explainer, product demo and launch videos for SaaS founders and tech companies. He is the founder of Motion Dojo.

Website: https://timxpert.com
Email: workwithtimxpert@gmail.com
Book a call: https://cal.com/timxpert-bn7l0a/meet.google.com-sbx-njmp-gyq
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/timxpert
X: https://x.com/timxpert
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/timothy-goodness-367708274

## What Timxpert does
- Explainer videos, product demos, launch videos, course promos, onboarding videos and how-to videos
- For SaaS founders, tech companies and course creators
- Cinematic motion design that makes complex products easy to understand in seconds

## Motion Dojo
- Timxpert founded Motion Dojo in 2025: a creative community that helps smartphone creatives become skillful motion designers.
- Motion Dojo website: https://joinmotiondojo.com
